name: AiApiKey
title: Blocks/Ai/AiApiKey
summary: Bring your own key: the reader connects their own model provider account by picking a provider in a `Select`, pasting the key in a masked `PasswordInput` (reveal toggle, never prefilled, cleared once saved) and saving it; a status row says whether a key is saved for that provider (only its masked tail shows); Save key with an empty field marks it with a `FieldError`; Test connection checks the key (running, connected or failed with the provider's message in an `Alert` with Test again) and Remove key deletes it after a `ConfirmDialog`. The block stores nothing: it emits save, test and remove for the app's key store (TanStack AI's `useByok`). Built from `PageHeader`, `Subheader`, `Card`, `Item`, `SettingsRow`, `Select`, `PasswordInput`, `FieldError`, `StatusIndicator`, `Alert`, `Button` and `ConfirmDialog`. A page body for ConsoleLayout.
intents: chave de api do provedor de ia
usar mi propia clave de api

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No key is saved for any provider: the status reads No key saved and only Save key shows.

variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: The key is being saved: the Provider Select, the API key field, Test connection and Remove key lock and Save key spins, keeping focus.

variants.name: Testing
variants.summary: Test connection is running: the status reads Testing with a spinner, Test connection spins, and Remove key and the Provider Select lock until it settles; Save key stays available for a replacement key.

variants.name: Success
variants.summary: The test passed: the status reads Connected.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The test failed: the status reads Connection failed and a danger Alert gives the provider's message with Test again.

variants.name: SaveError
variants.summary: The save failed: a danger Alert says the key wasn't saved with the reason and no action; the typed key stays in the field and Save key retries.
